prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: ONE concept comparison board for a plush bubble-shooter game, preview only.
Inputs: Image 1 is the EXACT current blue bear; image 2 the EXACT current charcoal penguin; image 3 the EXACT current white cat. Treat them as the character edit targets. Preserve species, silhouette, pose, facial expression, head/body/pot proportions, fine fluffy fur, clean felt flowerpot rim, existing applique motifs, lighting and camera. Do not invent new toys.
Create a polished landscape 1536x1024 comparison sheet with THREE columns (bear, penguin, cat) and TWO rows (current, proposed), on the same pale lavender #E9DFF5 flat background in every cell. All toys same scale, whole pots visible, no clipping. Restrained editorial layout, generous spacing, thin dividers, crisp dark purple Chinese labels.
Title: “颜色识别优化 · 示意对照”
Column labels: “蓝色 · 小熊”, “黑色 · 企鹅”, “白色 · 猫咪”.
Top row label: “当前版”. Reproduce the three supplied toys as accurately as possible, including their ORIGINAL color distribution. Blue bear has cream muzzle and inner ears, green leaves, blue pot. Penguin has a large ivory face/chest, green leaves, charcoal pot with light snowflakes. White cat has warm white fur, green leaves and a CREAM WHITE pot with pale lavender flowers (do not mistakenly give the current cat a purple pot).
Bottom row label: “同色系调整”. Place the exact same three toys under their originals, changing COLOR only as follows:
1. Blue bear: keep saturated medium royal blue #2982F4 as dominant identity. Replace the large cream double muzzle with clearly BLUE fur, slightly lighter medium blue #4B99F2, not pale icy cyan and NOT near-white. Inner ears also medium/light blue. Make the cloud and dots on the pot light blue, not white. Keep tiny dark nose and eye whites for expression. The entire head and pot should read instantly as BLUE.
2. Penguin: retain its distinct rounded penguin silhouette and black head/flippers. Replace the large white facial bib and chest with DARK CHARCOAL GRAY, about #505057, keeping slightly darker gray around the outer edge. Reduce the apparent pale patch area through same-hue shading. Entire face/head/chest/pot should read CHARCOAL BLACK, NOT gray-white. Only the two eye whites and a small warm yellow beak remain contrasting accents. Snowflake appliques on the pot become medium charcoal gray rather than white. Keep plush fibers and enough soft light to show volume; do not crush into a featureless black silhouette.
3. White cat: keep white fur and the pink nose/inner ears small. Change the creamy warm pot to CLEAN SOFT WHITE with subtle cool-light-gray shading; flower appliques and centers become pearl white/light gray, removing purple and yellow accents. Maintain clear depth against lavender backdrop using soft cool-gray edge shading and a restrained contact shadow. White cat must remain soft and lively, not washed out or flat.
All six retain small green leaf collars, with identical position and proportion; leaves are secondary accents, not dominant. Keep eyes alive, fur soft and dimensional. No outline stickers, no fake furry noise, no seams or loose threads on pot rims, no weapons, no added accessories.
At the very bottom add a compact “缩小对照” strip: repeat a small original/adjusted pair for each of the three columns, with labels “前” and “后”, to compare quick color recognition at game-icon size. These miniature versions must match the large figures exactly.
Footer: “仅用于方案比较，尚未替换游戏素材”
Show a noticeable decisive improvement in dominant-color coverage in the bottom row, rather than a barely visible color change. The top row must remain faithful to the inputs.
